_readme: The publisher agent adds each new video here at publish time (newest last). Fields: id, type (episode|compilation|short), title, story (the public-domain tale it retells), youtube (video id), date (YYYY-MM-DD, day it went public), length (m:ss), thumb (path in img/ep, optional). 'next' is the next planned episode; set it to null when nothing is scheduled.
